# Vendored ProLeap COBOL Parser

This directory contains the pinned, offline-capable version of the `proleap-cobol-parser` library (MIT licensed).

## Details
- **Version**: 4.0.0
- **Commit**: `4c227db08e2f81156a04e578a1bc1b47427845f0`
- **Source**: [https://github.com/uwol/proleap-cobol-parser](https://github.com/uwol/proleap-cobol-parser)
- **Local Artifact**: `artifact/proleap-cobol-parser-4.0.0.jar`

This guarantees that the build and comparative testing suite run completely offline and remain operational even if the upstream repository is deleted or modified.
